takeaway.text: Vehicle privacy modification is now a documented, reproducible practice: the RAV4 modem/GPS removal post tops HN at 754 pts with a 0.54:1 ratio, marking the moment hardware privacy modification moved from enthusiast niche to mainstream practitioner discourse. Two concurrent security disclosures — Nginx-Rift (CVE-2026-42945, 18 years in the wild) and the first public M5 kernel memory corruption exploit developed with Anthropic Mythos in five days — establish that both web infrastructure and Apple's flagship hardware security feature are under coordinated, AI-accelerated attack research simultaneously.
